xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5597: Order books page: show which book is live, and make building and running a book simple

plan.title: Order books page: show which book is live, and make building and running a book simple
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One page rework approved as one PRD and one mockup. The new page replaces nine components that the current page imports, so the page cannot ship half-replaced; the server phase field exists only for this page and the Flywheel card. A server/UI sibling split would still fail the lint, because the docs, scripts baselines, changelog and skill files each count as their own subsystem. Items are already decomposed into 22 independently verifiable slices with a staged DAG (foundations, additive components, swaps, one cleanup).

narratives.Problem: The Order books page never says which book the Flywheel works from, draws three lifecycle steps nothing ever writes, offers no way to unqueue, archive or rename a book, reports every landed issue as a blocking error (so a partly landed book cannot start), truncates issue titles, splits one list into Setup and Progress views, uses jargon and wrong off-book copy, hides the main action at the bottom, and splits adding issues across two rails. The Flywheel skill also only reads a book that is 'bound' or 'running', and nothing ever writes 'running'.
narratives.Proposal: Derive phase (draft/active/queued/archived), queue position and finished on the server from currentOrderBook (moved to src/lib/orders/phase.ts) and return them on every book. Extend PATCH /api/orders/:id with unqueue (ready->draft), archive (draft/ready->complete) and restore (complete->draft, refused 409 when an issue joined another live book). Stop counting landed issues as blockers in non-draft books. Add pan orders unqueue/archive/unarchive and a Phase column in pan orders list. Rebuild the page per the mockup: left book list grouped by phase, a header with one sentence and phase actions, notices, one issue list with two stacked lanes and plain waiting reasons, one Add issues panel. The Flywheel status, card and skill follow the active book. Docs, screenshots and changelog follow.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing which book dispatch treats as active (currentOrderBook keeps its rule), or auto-advancing the queue past a finished book.
- Reordering the queue.
- Deleting a book file.
- Committing order-book writes made through the dashboard routes (the CLI commits; routes do not).
- New HTTP routes, no-loss-matrix rows or route-scopes entries.
- New stored state or changes to the OrderBook file shape or status literals.
- The Backlog page's '+ Order book' action, BacklogSequencerPage's promotionTarget logic and its two generic /orders links, and the issue action menu's 'Add to order book' action.
- Changing the off-book dispatch message in src/lib/orders/eligibility.ts.
- Editing .claude/skills/ sync targets directly.
- Raising or adding any react-compiler, manual-memo, file-size or allowlist row.

items.title: Derive book phase, queue position and finished in src/lib/orders/phase.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/lib/orders/phase.ts. Move currentOrderBook from src/lib/cloister/flywheel.ts into it unchanged (anchor: '/** The book in flight: the running one, or the next one queued up ready. */'); flywheel.ts imports it from '../orders/phase.js' and does not re-export it; the cloister test imports it from src/lib/orders/phase.js. Add OrderBookPhase ('draft'|'active'|'queued'|'archived'), OrderBookPhaseView {phase, queuePosition, finished} and deriveBookPhases(books, progressOf) returning Map<bookId, view>. Rules in order: complete -> archived, null position; draft -> draft, null position; otherwise active when the book is currentOrderBook(books), else queued; queuePosition = 1-based index in books.filter(status not draft/complete) with the active book moved to position 1; finished = progress.total > 0 && progress.drained for every phase. phase.ts imports only types from @overdeck/contracts: never from src/lib/cloister/ or src/lib/orders/resolver.ts (lint:circular). Tests named in PRD WI-1.

items.title: Given books in index order with statuses ready, ready, draft, when deriveBookPhases runs, then it returns active with queuePosition 1, queued with queuePosition 2, and draft with queuePosition null.
Given an earlier ready book and a later running book, when deriveBookPhases runs, then the running book is active with queuePosition 1 and the ready book is queued with queuePosition 2.
Given a book with zero items, when deriveBookPhases runs, then finished is false; given a non-empty book whose progress is drained, then finished is true in every phase including archived.

Given the move, when tests/unit/lib/cloister/flywheel-active-order-book.test.ts imports currentOrderBook from src/lib/orders/phase.js, then its existing assertions still pass and src/lib/cloister/flywheel.ts no longer exports currentOrderBook.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 step 2 'Restore guard' (Amendment 1). Export assertRestorable(panDir, book) from src/lib/orders/writer.ts beside setStatus. It lists books with listBooks(panDir); for each item of the given book in item order (upper-cased issue id), if another book (id !== book.id) whose status is not 'complete' contains the issue, throw new Error(`Order book ${book.id} cannot be restored: ${ISSUE} already belongs to order book ${otherId}`) for the first conflict. Otherwise return. It does not write anything. Callers (route and CLI) call it only when the book's current status is 'complete' and the target is 'draft'.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 step 1. In enrichedBook (src/dashboard/server/routes/orders.ts) add phase, queuePosition and finished from deriveBookPhases(books, (b) => computeBookProgress(b, issueLookup)), books = snapshot?.books ?? listBooks(stateRoot). In getOrdersPayload compute the map once from the snapshot and pass it into enrichedBook so a list read does not recompute it per book. If the book is missing from the map (a write raced), fall back to {phase: complete->'archived', draft->'draft', else 'queued', queuePosition: null, finished: false}. getOrderPayload's cross-project scan path calls listBooks on the scanned project's panDir (CP-3). narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 step 2. Replace the status guard in patchOrderPayload (anchor "status may only transition to ready through this route"). Allowed: ready from draft (message unchanged); draft from ready or complete ('Order book <id> must be queued or archived before it can be moved back to draft'); complete from draft or ready ('Order book <id> must be draft or queued before it can be archived'). Other targets: 'status may only transition to ready, draft, or complete through this route'. Keep 'runId is server-controlled'. When the current status is complete and the target is draft, call assertRestorable(stateRoot, book) from src/lib/orders/writer.ts before writing (409 via the existing 'already belongs' errorResult pattern). Then setStatus(stateRoot, bookId, target). No new route, no no-loss-matrix row, no route-scopes entry. Tests (PRD WI-2): moves a ready book back to draft; archives a ready book and frees the active slot for the next ready book; restores an archived book as a draft; refuses to restore an archived book whose issue now belongs to another book with a 409; refuses complete to ready with a 400; starts a ready book whose landed issues are closed (POST /api/orders/:id/start returns 200, not 422).

Given an archived book whose issue now belongs to a queued book, when the client sends PATCH {"status":"draft"}, then the route returns 409 with 'cannot be restored: <ISSUE> already belongs to order book <otherId>' and the book stays complete.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 steps 2, 3 and 5. BookIssueList props: book, project?, onBookChange?, onError?, readOnly?. Props contract (shared by BookHeader, BookIssueList, AddIssuesPanel, MoreSettings): book: OrderBookView; project?: string (appended as ?project= to every request it sends); onBookChange?: (book: OrderBookView) => void (called with the server's returned book after a successful mutation); onError?: (message: string) => void (called with the response body's error text, or the HTTP status text when there is none, after a failed mutation). project, onBookChange and onError are optional so the read-only Flywheel card can omit them. Two stacked full-width sections: 'Parallel lane' with 'Up to [-] <n> [+] issues run at the same time.' (stepper saves {settings:{laneAConcurrency}} with a 500 ms debounce, range 1-8, tag 'Lane A'), and 'One-at-a-time lane' with 'Runs top to bottom, one issue at a time. Use it for work that would collide.' (tag 'Lane B'). Non-landed rows in order, then a footer '▸ Show <k> landed' / '▾ Hide <k> landed'; a lane with only landed rows shows them and no footer. Empty-lane texts as in the PRD. Keep LaneEditor's HTML5 drag/drop (PATCH .../items/:issue {lane, order}) and accept drops from the Add issues panel: a drop whose dataTransfer has type 'application/x-overdeck-order-issue' (value = upper-case issue id) posts {item:{issue, lane}} to POST .../items for that lane section; a drop without that type is an in-list move as today. IssueRow per PRD WI-6 step 3: grip, position (font-mono, no '· book'), issue id link via trackerIssueUrl (plain text when null, CP-2), full title with ellipsis and title attribute, hover/focus actions 'Run one at a time'/'Run in parallel', 'Options', 'Remove', status tag from itemStatus; muted second line only for 'after <ids>', 're-check PRD first', 'plan when it starts', 'no PRD'; Options inline block with the three fields and Save/Cancel saving prereqs/reVerify/planAtPickup. Left border colors per status; no 'PRD ✓' chip. readOnly renders no grips, actions, stepper buttons or drop targets. Do not carry over the posture banner, posture buttons, stale-reason flag or off-book block. Signal tints use the pattern border-info/[0.32] bg-info/[0.08] text-info-foreground; no opacity on var() tokens. Tests in PRD WI-6 (debounce test uses vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync).

Props contract (shared by BookHeader, BookIssueList, AddIssuesPanel, MoreSettings): book: OrderBookView; project?: string (appended as ?project= to every request it sends); onBookChange?: (book: OrderBookView) => void (called with the server's returned book after a successful mutation); onError?: (message: string) => void (called with the response body's error text, or the HTTP status text when there is none, after a failed mutation). project, onBookChange and onError are optional so the read-only Flywheel card can omit them.
